groups.title: Mermaid Man & Barnacle Boy
groups.def: The Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy franchise's own characters: the two heroes and their arch-villains Man Ray and the Dirty Bubble. Townspeople who suit up for an episode (SpongeBob as the Quickster, Plankton joining E.V.I.L.) don't count.

groups.title: Fish
groups.def: Characters whose wiki species is a fish: Mrs. Puff (porcupine pufferfish), Bubble Bass (bass), Fred (grouper), Old Man Jenkins and Perch Perkins ("Fish"), Flats (flounder) and Mystery (seahorse; the wiki: "Seahorses are a genus of fish"). Not Pearl (sperm whale), Patrick (sea star), merpeople, crustaceans, molluscs or humans named after sea animals (Man Ray).

groups.title: Humans & merpeople
groups.def: Characters whose wiki species is human or merfolk: the humans Mermaid Man, Barnacle Boy, Man Ray, Patchy, the French Narrator and Burger-Beard (Category:Humans); the Flying Dutchman, a cursed human sailor (species "Ghost of a human"; human again for a day in Search for SquarePants); and the merfolk King Neptune, Princess Mindy, King Poseidon and Triton (Category:Mermaids; Neptune and Triton are also gods). Not Lord Royal Highness (an alien Atlantean), Painty (a painting), Potty (a parrot) or any sea animal.

groups.title: Royalty
groups.def: Characters who are or were royalty in the show or movies: King Neptune, his children Princess Mindy and Triton, King Poseidon (king of Atlantic City), Lord Royal Highness (emperor of Atlantis), Patrick (crowned King of Bikini Bottom) and Gary (the true heir who takes the crown) in "Rule of Dumb", and Plankton, who overthrows the Sea Chimp King and takes his crown in "King Plankton". Storybook and medieval counterparts (Queen Karen, King Krabs, Princess Pearl Krabs) are separate characters. SpongeBob only proclaims himself "Emperor of the Sea" in "Trident Trouble"; since that is arguable, this group avoids every group SpongeBob is in.

groups.title: Sea sponges
groups.def: Every character in the bank whose wiki species is a sea sponge: SpongeBob, his grandmother, his father Harold and his mother Margaret. DoodleBob is a pencil doodle (species "Doodle"), not a sponge.

groups.title: Live-action characters
groups.def: Characters the show presents in live action (the wiki's Category:Live-action characters): Patchy, his marionette parrot Potty, Painty, the French Narrator (on screen in live action from "Feral Friends" on) and Burger-Beard. Animated characters drawn into live-action scenes don't count; King Neptune's one live-action cameo at Patchy's party ("Party Pooper Pants") is arguable, so Royalty avoids this group.

groups.title: Worked at the Chum Bucket
groups.def: Characters shown holding a job at the Chum Bucket: owners Plankton and Karen, SpongeBob ("Welcome to the Chum Bucket"), Patrick (Fry Cook Games, "Chum Bucket Supreme"), Pearl (intern, "Plankton's Intern"), Squidward ("Chum Fricassee") and Bubble Bass (hired by Karen in "Painfully Employed", S17). Mind-controlled minions (Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy hypnotised into endorsing it in "Mermaid Man vs. SpongeBob", the bucket-helmeted townsfolk of the 2004 movie) and robot/clone copies don't count.

groups.title: Boating School
groups.def: Mrs. Puff and everyone the show enrolls as a student at her boating school: SpongeBob, Patrick ("New Student Starfish", "Driven to Tears"), Squidward ("Boating Buddies"), Flats ("The Bully"), Mr. Krabs ("Tutor Sauce", "Teacher's Pests") and Plankton ("Teacher's Pests"). The Flying Dutchman is a student only in a comic (out of scope).

groups.title: Named "___ the [Species]"
groups.def: Display names (the wiki's page titles) of the form "[Name] the [X]" where X is the character's actual wiki species: Larry the Lobster, Flats the Flounder, Mystery the Seahorse, Gary the Snail (a sea snail) and Potty the Parrot. Patchy and Painty "the Pirate" don't count (a pirate isn't a species); names that merely contain an animal (Bubble Bass, SpongeBob) lack the pattern.

groups.title: Krabs family
groups.def: Mr. Krabs and his relatives seen on screen: daughter Pearl, mother Mama Krabs, father Krabs Senior (physically from "Senior Discount") and paternal grandfather Redbeard Krabs ("Grandpappy the Pirate"). Plankton only dates Mama Krabs ("Enemy In-Law", she turns him down); medieval/storybook counterparts (King Krabs, Princess Pearl Krabs) are separate characters not in the file.

groups.title: Crustaceans
groups.def: Characters whose wiki species is a crustacean: the crabs Mr. Krabs (Dungeness crab), Mama Krabs (Florida stone crab), Krabs Senior and Redbeard Krabs, Larry (lobster) and Plankton (planktonic copepod, listed under Crustaceans on the wiki's List of species). Not Pearl (sperm whale), Barnacle Boy (a human despite his name), or the molluscs Squidward and Gary.

groups.title: Joined E.V.I.L.
groups.def: Members of the supervillain team E.V.I.L. (Every Villain Is Lemons): Man Ray and the Dirty Bubble, Barnacle Boy as "Barnacle Man" ("Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy V"), and Plankton as "Captain Pipsqueak" ("Captain Pipsqueak"). Squidward (as Dr. Negative) and DoodleBob audition in that episode but are rejected.

groups.title: Not flesh and blood
groups.def: Characters whose wiki species is not a flesh-and-blood being: Karen (computer), Painty (painting), the Dirty Bubble (bubble), DoodleBob (pencil doodle) and the Flying Dutchman (ghost). Gods and merpeople count as flesh and blood. Potty is a parrot in-story but visibly a marionette (his puppeteer appears in "Christmas Who?"), so this group avoids every group Potty is in.

groups.title: Alliterative names
groups.def: Display names whose first and last words start with the same letter: SpongeBob SquarePants, Perch Perkins, Bubble Bass, Mermaid Man, Barnacle Boy, Burger-Beard, Patchy the Pirate, Painty the Pirate, Potty the Parrot, Flats the Flounder, Larry the Lobster.

groups.title: Names containing "man"
groups.def: Display names containing the letters "man" anywhere: Mermaid Man, Man Ray, Old Man Jenkins and Flying Dutchman (script-checked over every name in the file; Mama Krabs and Grandma SquarePants don't contain it).

groups.title: Name says the wrong sea creature
groups.def: Display names containing a sea-creature word that isn't the character's species: Squidward (an octopus, not a squid), Pearl Krabs (a sperm whale, not a crab) and the humans Barnacle Boy, Man Ray and Mermaid Man. Names whose creature word matches (SpongeBob, Patrick Star, Mr. Krabs and the other crab Krabses, Mrs. Puff, Bubble Bass, Perch Perkins, Plankton, Larry, Flats, Mystery, Gary) don't count, and "man" isn't a sea creature (Old Man Jenkins, Flying Dutchman).
